structured.answer: I'd pick Harel's "כספי (שקלי)" track: 0% shares, 0% dollars, and about 4.25% a year over 3 years. It's the closest thing to my deposit. But before I put money in, I'd ask my son or the bank what it really is and whether it beats my deposit after the 0.57% fee.
